Submit a support ticket

Tell us what is going wrong. We reply to confirm the details and schedule a remote session at a time that suits you.

Contact information
The issue
Urgency

What happens, when it started, and any error message. Do not include passwords, PINs, or recovery codes.

Attachments

File uploads will be available once secure file handling is in place. If a screenshot would help, we will ask for it by email after we reply.

This form is not connected yet

You can fill it in and we will check every field, but submissions are not sent anywhere until Jemawe connects a secure form service. Nothing you type is stored.

How sessions work

Remote sessions start only when you approve them on your screen, and you can end them at any time. Read our session rules.

What we ask for, and why

  • Only what we need to reply and understand the request.
  • Never passwords, PINs, or payment details.
  • Replies are handled during business hours, not around the clock.
